segments.text: Standup. Same shape: done, next, blockers. Then decisions since last standup, then stale commitments. Sana, you first this time.
Done: onboarding screens, all five, delivered Saturday the 19th with the fifty-six dp buttons. They're in Figma, Rahul has the link.
Yep. Started building them this morning.
Next: the payment screens review against the checklist, and I'm helping Rahul with the drawer states. Blockers: none.
Good. Rahul.
Done: tab bar is out, drawer is in on my branch. It should merge tomorrow, so on track for the 23rd.
The offline sync queue is working on a real device now, replay and all.
Conflicts?
Last-write-wins per field is in, with the toast Sana wanted. Next: I want to demo the whole offline flow end to end next Monday, the 28th.
Put it down. Blockers?
Yes, actually. Test devices. I'm testing on my Pixel, which is not a five inch rugged thing you use with gloves. I need two of Meridian's actual devices.
I can lend you my old Moto, it's five inch.
It's not rugged and it doesn't come with gloves, but sure, thanks.
I have the Meridian call on Wednesday. I'll ask them for two test devices then.
Thanks.
Priya.
Okay. UPI flow. You've all seen my email from Thursday: it's Monday the 28th now, not the 25th. I'm confirming that here so it's on the record.
I saw it. That's the second slip, Priya. The 25th was supposed to be real.
I know. And the flow itself is done, the polling works, the one-time path works. What moved is UPI autopay, the mandates Meridian wants.
Razorpay's merchant KYC for mandates is five business days, not three like they told me.
It unlocks Thursday the 24th at the earliest, and I need two days to test mandates properly.
So the date isn't your code, it's their KYC.
Mostly. The 28th is honest. I'm not going to say the 25th and then email you again.
Okay. The UPI flow is Monday the 28th. That's the last move. If it slips again we cut mandates from the release, like I said in the email.
Agreed. If KYC isn't through by Thursday, I'll say so on Thursday.
Also, repeating from the email so it's on the record: payments service deployed to staging by Friday the 25th, with the one-time UPI flow.
So Rahul can test against a real endpoint instead of my branch.
That would help a lot.
Blockers?
Only the KYC thing, and the offline payments question, which is still open.
Right. Me. Meridian signed off the drawer mockup on Friday the 18th, no changes. Farah from their compliance team replied on the thread.
Oh, good.

Decisions since last standup. From the design review: the side drawer replaces the tab bar, Meridian's checklist is the baseline, fifty-six dp buttons, last-write-wins per field. Nothing new since Wednesday.
One new decision today, though. Code freeze is Friday, October 9th. One week before release. Nothing merges after that except fixes.
Eleven days from the UPI flow to freeze. Tight.
It is. That's why the 28th is the last move.
Stale commitments. The offline payments question has been open since the 14th. I'm closing it on Wednesday on the Meridian call, one way or the other.
Please.
Everything else has a date or is done. Rahul, your drawer is due the 23rd, you said tomorrow, so fine.
The Meridian call is Wednesday the 23rd at nine, Priya's joining. We'll do a recap at ten for you two.
Okay.
Anything else? No? Go.
Bye.
